Nile's own photograph of the stone they list as 'Calacatta Gold/ Oro' in their MARBLE section. ⚠️ Only 384px of clean slab was reachable in that frame, so this tile is a 4.2x upscale and is the weakest image in the range. ⛔ Do not swap it for a generic 'Calacatta Gold' found elsewhere: the name is a marketing name and other makers' products under it look completely different.

RE-CROPPED 10 Aug AT SLAB SCALE. The old tile was a tight zoom on a quiet patch of the same slab: correct provenance, but it showed a few thin veins on blank white and read as a different, plainer stone than the one a customer finds when they google the name. This window is the FULL SLAB HEIGHT (2956px native, no enlargement) and carries the diagonal copper-gold veining the stone is known for. ⭐ The general rule this sets: a tile has to show the stone at a scale where its PATTERN is recognisable, not just at the right resolution.
